blocks.text: Move more freight with the same team.
We automate dispatch, route planning, shipment tracking, customer updates, and invoicing, all connected to your TMS, WMS, and ERP, so ops managers stop firefighting and start scaling.
Teams we ship for
The stack we ship on
Engineers stopped being the bottleneck.
The bottleneck moved to orchestration. Claude Code is the brain, MCP plugs into your TMS, WMS, and ERP, E2B sandboxes every action. One of our engineers ships like three normal hires.

Dispatch, routing, and freight ops on autopilot

Tendering, route planning, and carrier selection still living in spreadsheets and inboxes? We wire them into your TMS so loads get assigned, priced, and tracked without a planner clicking through five tools.
Loads tendered to the right carrier in seconds
Rules check rate, lane history, and on-time score. Planners only see exceptions, not every shipment.
Route plans that adapt to reality
Traffic, weather, and ETA changes feed back into the plan. Drivers get the next stop, not yesterday's route sheet.
Freight invoice audit, automatically
Every carrier invoice checked against the rate confirmation. Discrepancies flagged before AP pays.
Warehouse picks, inventory sync, and fewer wrong-item shipments
We hook scanning, voice-pick, or vision flows into your WMS, then push counts back to your ERP and storefronts in real time.
Pick accuracy that survives Black Friday
Scan-to-confirm catches wrong-bin pulls before the box is taped.
Guided workflows for temp staff
New hires productive in hours. The system tells them the next bin, not a supervisor.
Slotting that moves with demand
Fast movers stay close to packing. Slow SKUs get pushed back without a manual re-slot.
Live inventory across WMS, ERP, and storefronts
Cycle counts replace annual shutdowns. Stock levels sync to NetSuite, SAP, Shopify, or your 3PL portal so sales and ops see the same number.
Last-mile delivery and customer updates that cut support tickets
Last mile is where margin disappears and complaints start. A driver app, live ETAs, and proactive SMS or email kill the "where is my order" queue.
Driver app the team will actually use
Stops, signatures, photo proof, and exceptions in one screen. Works offline when coverage drops.
Proactive customer notifications
Dispatch confirmations, day-of windows, 30-min heads-up, delivery photo. WISMO tickets drop by half within weeks.
Re-routing when the day goes sideways
A missed dock or traffic jam reshuffles remaining stops live. Dispatchers approve, don't recalculate.
International freight, customs docs, and 3PL handoffs
One missing document can park a container for a week. We automate the document pack, EDI/API exchanges with carriers, and status sync across legs so nothing stalls in someone's inbox.
Commercial invoices & packing lists
Auto-generated from the PO. Same data, no re-keying.
Bill of lading & ASN
Sent over EDI 204/210 or carrier API the moment a load is tendered.
Compliance screening
Denied-party and HS code checks before docs leave the building.
Multi-leg shipments in one view
Ocean to drayage to final mile, stitched together. Ops sees a single status, not three carrier portals.
